description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order No. 30 for fixing the maximum retail prices for 50 kg. bag of cement w.e.f.
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, establishing maximum retail prices for cement products. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters. The content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
